name: Healthy Dragon Scale
label: Quest
description: Healthy Dragon Scale: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling. But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred.
Betina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, do you have something to show me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge. Thank you, friend, and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!
